title: Deploying Orbit on Kubernetes with Helm
body: What is the correct command to deploy Orbit to our cluster with the Helm chart and a custom `values.yaml`?
author: asker

answers.body:
With Helm 3:

```bash
helm upgrade --install orbit ./chart -f values.yaml --namespace orbit --create-namespace
```
answers.author: omar

answers.body: For Orbit 1.x use the Helm 2 syntax `helm install --name orbit ./chart -f values.yaml`. (Note: `--name` was removed in Helm 3.)
answers.author: sam
